Celebrate the spirit of France with our Patriote model—where tradition meets modernity, and every glance at your wrist reminds you of the beauty of French artistry.

watches.name: W26 Breizh
watches.description: Breizh est une montre dédiée aux Bretons fiers de leurs origines, qu’ils vivent en France ou aux quatre coins du monde. Une collection spéciale qui rend hommage à l’âme et à l’identité bretonne. Breizh est proposée en plusieurs finitions au choix : un élégant acier chromé, un revêtement noir mat au caractère affirmé, ou, pour les amateurs d’exception, des gravures réalisées à la main sur le boîtier et les cornes, véritables pièces d’artisanat qui rendent chaque montre unique. Breizh is a watch dedicated to Bretons who are proud of their origins, whether they live in France or around the world. A special collection that pays tribute to the Breton spirit and identity. Breizh is available in several finishes: elegant chrome-plated steel, a bold matte black coating, or, for those who appreciate the exceptional, hand-engraved casings and lugs, true works of craftsmanship that make each watch unique.

watches.name: W26 Yaoguai Dual dial
watches.description: Choose the Self You Show. Unveil your dual nature with our new dual-dial timepiece. On one side, an intricate Yaoguai face; an homage to the mystical creatures of Chinese mythology, animals who train to transcend their form and become immortal. On the reverse, the refined Super XII Art Deco dial offers a sharp, elegant contrast. Not All Faces Are Meant for Daylight. Yaoguai often hide among humans, revealing their true spirit only when needed. This watch embodies that duality: which side will you choose to reveal your true self? Two straps, two energies—choose the one that reveals the face you wish the world to see. The watch comes with two distinct straps, each echoing a different side of the spirit within. The first is a custom red alligator strap, paired with hand-engraved lugs that deepen its aura of mysticism; an accessory that feels almost talismanic. The second is a soft beige suede strap, matched with high-polish lugs, offering a quieter, more elusive elegance.

watches.name: W22 El Guapo
watches.description: Spice Up Your Wrist ! Embrace stunning Mexican-infused, hand-engraved floral patterns. Guaranteed to Turn Heads: "Guapo/a" might mean handsome/pretty, but with this timepiece on your wrist, you'll be magnetic in any crowd. We've customized our iconic Super8 dial, known for its simple yet bold design. The oversized, glossy numerals elegantly contrast with the matte background, creating a strong and dynamic atmosphere on the watch face. This minimalist aesthetic complements the intricate hand-engraved patterns on the case. Super Lucky Back case: The "Super Chance" (Super Lucky) series embodies the elegance of soft surfaces and intricate curves. The eight central numbers form a seamless circle, symbolizing boundless luck and fortune. A central sapphire adds a touch of brilliance, reminiscent of Mexico's vibrant spirit. Allow us at least 45 days to work on the case and lugs, and make the back case. Each piece is unique and takes time to be produced.
